Definition: middle voice from G5259 and G2919; to decide (speak or act) under a false part, i.e. (figuratively) dissemble (pretend):--feign.
BiblicalUsage: hypokrínomai means to act a part, to pretend. In Luke 20:20, the text says "which should feign themselves just men."
TheologicalSignificance: I take hypokrínomai as it stands: to act a part, to pretend.
